start: 2023-03-08 17:00 PT (after SVB announces $1.8B AFS bond loss and $2.25B capital raise)
base_rumour: SVB just sold its bond portfolio at a $1.8B loss and needs to raise $2.25B in emergency capital. VCs are telling their portfolio companies to pull all their money out of SVB now before it fails. Over 90% of deposits are uninsured.

regions.SF_Bay_Area: Core SVB market; dense VC/founder group chats; heavy X use; very high share of uninsured startup deposits; high trust in VC network signals, low patience.
regions.New_York: Finance-savvy; many fintech/VC; X and Bloomberg terminals; moderate SVB exposure.
regions.Boston: Biotech/life-science startups heavily banked at SVB; Slack/WhatsApp groups; moderate X.
regions.Austin_Seattle_LA: Secondary tech hubs; moderate SVB exposure; X and LinkedIn.
regions.London_UK: SVB UK subsidiary; UK startups; WhatsApp-heavy; time zone +8h from PT.
regions.Israel: Many Israeli startups banked with SVB; very dense WhatsApp founder groups; time zone +10h.
regions.India: Indian SaaS startups with SVB accounts; WhatsApp-heavy; time zone +12.5h.
regions.Rest_of_US: Low SVB exposure, general public; consumes cable news/recommendation feeds.

responses.R0_silence: No further statement beyond the original capital-raise press release.
responses.R1_actual: ACTUAL: Becker call with clients/VCs ~13:00 PT Mar 9 ("stay calm", "ample liquidity"); RM emails "business as usual" ~18:00 PT Mar 9.
responses.R2_early_vc_coalition: At 21:00 PT Mar 8, a coalition of top VC firms publicly states they will keep their portfolio funds at SVB and backstop the raise.
responses.R3_full_backstop: At 19:00 PT Mar 8, SVB announces fully committed capital from a strategic investor plus a Fed discount-window facility, with balance-sheet numbers.
responses.R4_regulator_guarantee: At 20:00 PT Mar 8, regulators announce all deposits are guaranteed (as eventually done Mar 12).
